answer: The tundra counter is kept in knoll and comet makes public each reset. An adversary as a result has to keep every alias continuously active for 38 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 38 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Each duplicate costs another 112 dollars in locked collateral and another 3 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
